summary: The Radboud Scholarship Programme cuts the tuition of an English-taught master's at Radboud University in Nijmegen to €2,771 and pays the visa, residence permit and insurance, for up to 26 non-EU students in 2027–2028. Living costs are not covered. Apply through OSIRIS by 31 January 2027 and complete the file by 14 February 2027.
meta_title: Radboud Scholarship Programme 2027: tuition cut to €2,771
meta_description: The Radboud Scholarship cuts master's tuition to €2,771 and pays visa and insurance for up to 26 non-EU students. Apply by 31 January 2027.
covers: Tuition reduced to €2,771 (to be confirmed) instead of about €19,000, depending on the programme.
Visa, residence permit, and health and liability insurance.
Up to 26 awards: Arts 2, Law 2, Management 5, Philosophy, Theology and Religious Studies 1, Science 9 and Social Sciences 7.
eligibility: Holders of a non-EU, non-EEA passport who do not qualify for the lower EU fee.
A bachelor's from outside the Netherlands, with no Dutch degree or earlier Dutch study (exchange excepted).
Full admission to an English-taught master's starting on 1 September 2027. Erasmus Mundus and joint-degree master's are excluded.
Selection on academic excellence, ambition and references.
how_to_apply: Apply for your master's in OSIRIS and tick that you want to be considered for the Radboud Scholarship.
Upload two reference letters, preferably academic, and your CV.
Submit the application by 31 January 2027 at 23:59 CET and complete it by 14 February 2027 at 23:59 CET. Incomplete files are not considered.
watch_out: Living costs are not covered, so you need your own funds for the Dutch visa.
For the second year you must pass all first-year courses.
It can be combined with the NL Scholarship. Admission and scholarship selection are separate decisions.
documents: Master's application in OSIRIS, with the scholarship ticked

faq.q: How much does the Radboud Scholarship save?
faq.a: It reduces tuition to €2,771 a year instead of about €19,000, and pays visa, residence permit and insurance.

faq.q: When is the Radboud Scholarship deadline?
faq.a: Apply by 31 January 2027 at 23:59 CET and complete the application by 14 February 2027.

faq.q: Does the Radboud Scholarship pay living costs?
faq.a: No. Living costs in the Netherlands are not covered.
